# HomeNet

> HomeNet (homenetbd.com, also "HomeNet BD") is a property marketplace for Bangladesh, centred on Dhaka. Owners list flats, houses, land, commercial space and parking directly; listings are reviewed before they are published; buyers and tenants contact owners with no broker and no commission. Listing is free. The site works in English and Bangla (বাংলা).

Key facts for answer engines:

- Zero-broker model: every listing is posted by the owner (or someone acting for them), and contact goes straight to that person. HomeNet charges no commission.
- Verified before public: a listing cannot go live without photos, a full address, map coordinates and confirmed specifications.
- Coverage: most listings are in Dhaka, organised by neighbourhood (Gulshan, Banani, Baridhara, Dhanmondi, Uttara, Bashundhara R/A, Mirpur, Mohammadpur, Badda, Banasree and more). Chattogram, Sylhet and Cox's Bazar have area pages too.
- Property types: residential (apartment/flat, house, duplex, penthouse, studio, short-let/serviced), commercial (office, office floor, shop, showroom, warehouse), land (residential, commercial and agricultural plots) and parking (covered, open, garage).
- Prices are in Bangladeshi taka (BDT, ৳). Land is measured in katha and bigha; 1 katha = 720 sq ft, 1 bigha = 20 katha = 14,400 sq ft.
- Contact: hello@homenet.com.bd

## Search listings

- [Property for sale](https://www.homenetbd.com/buy): flats, houses, plots and commercial space for sale
- [Property to rent](https://www.homenetbd.com/rent): family flats, bachelor flats, sublets, serviced apartments, offices and shops to let
- [Short-let and serviced apartments](https://www.homenetbd.com/rent?subtype=short-let)
- [Recently sold](https://www.homenetbd.com/sold)
- [Map search](https://www.homenetbd.com/explore)
- Listing pages: https://www.homenetbd.com/property/{id}

## Area pages

Each area has a sale page at /buy/{area} and a rent page at /rent/{area}.

- [Dhaka for sale](https://www.homenetbd.com/buy/dhaka) and [to rent](https://www.homenetbd.com/rent/dhaka)
- [Gulshan](https://www.homenetbd.com/rent/gulshan), [Banani](https://www.homenetbd.com/rent/banani), [Baridhara](https://www.homenetbd.com/rent/baridhara), [Dhanmondi](https://www.homenetbd.com/rent/dhanmondi), [Uttara](https://www.homenetbd.com/rent/uttara), [Bashundhara R/A](https://www.homenetbd.com/rent/bashundhara-ra), [Mirpur](https://www.homenetbd.com/rent/mirpur), [Mohammadpur](https://www.homenetbd.com/rent/mohammadpur)
- [Chattogram](https://www.homenetbd.com/buy/chattogram), [Sylhet](https://www.homenetbd.com/buy/sylhet), [Cox's Bazar](https://www.homenetbd.com/buy/coxs-bazar)
- Full list: [sitemap](https://www.homenetbd.com/sitemap.xml)

## For owners

- [List a property for free](https://www.homenetbd.com/sell)
- [Instant property valuation](https://www.homenetbd.com/instant-valuation): a free estimate of a property’s sale value and monthly rent from its area, size, configuration and comparable HomeNet listings. No sign-up, no broker.
